source.title: Alberto Ascari — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson
source.locator: Claim-specific Hall of Fame paragraph or section recorded in each claim.evidence.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 source inspected on 2026-10-24; per-claim locators record relevant sections. Independent publisher corroboration and EN/UK human review pending.

claims.en: Ascari won consecutive Formula 1 Drivers' World Championships in 1952 and 1953 with Ferrari.
claims.uk: Аскарі здобув два поспіль титули чемпіона світу Формули-1 у 1952 та 1953 роках із Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Given his family responsibilities': Ferrari titles in 1952 and 1953, six and five wins.

claims.en: Ascari died in a testing accident at Monza on 26 May 1955.
claims.uk: Аскарі загинув під час випробувального заїзду в Монці 26 травня 1955 року.

evidence.locator: Final career paragraphs: Monza Ferrari sports-car test crash on third lap and date May 26, 1955.
